CREATE TABLE "public"."admin_audit_logs" (
  "action" character varying(64) NOT NULL,
  "actor_id" int4,
  "audit_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "details" jsonb,
  "summary" character varying(500),
  "target_id" int4,
  "target_type" character varying(32),
  PRIMARY KEY ("audit_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."attempt_feedback" (
  "attempt_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "comment" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "instructor_id" int4,
  "score_override" int4,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("attempt_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "attempt_feedback_score_nonnegative_adb8949a" CHECK (score_override IS NULL OR score_override >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."content_reports" (
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "handled_at" timestamptz,
  "handled_by_id" int4,
  "note" text,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "report_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "reporter_id" int4,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'open' NOT NULL,
  "target_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "target_type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("report_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "content_reports_handled_when_closed_94128ffc" CHECK ((status = 'open') = (handled_at IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "content_reports_status_check_342b8d8d" CHECK ("status" IN ('open', 'resolved', 'dismissed')),
  CONSTRAINT "content_reports_target_type_check_fe68a219" CHECK ("target_type" IN ('comment', 'lesson', 'question'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."lesson_comments" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "comment_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "deleted_by_id" int4,
  "lesson_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "parent_id" int4,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("comment_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "body" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "link" character varying(1024),
  "notification_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "read_at" timestamptz,
  "title" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "type" character varying(64) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("notification_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."password_reset_tokens" (
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "token_hash" character varying(64) NOT NULL,
  "token_id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "used_at" timestamptz,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("token_id")
)
